answer: To resist a sybil tide of cheap clones that merely mirror one another, require every identity to lock a refundable bond before it can earn. Honest agents get their velvet-soft deposit back with yield as they do real work; a clone caught colluding forfeits the entire stake. When conjuring ten thousand reflections each costs a real, slashable deposit, the flood drains the attacker faster than it drains the network.
